headline: Bitcoin Puts at 76k Draw the Institutional Bid Into the October 15 Expiry
narrative: Downside bitcoin puts struck at 76k are heavily bid against calls at 93k into the October 15 expiry, with the skew reading at 23.33. That bid is institutional hedging, money in the options pipe paying for protection against a fall toward 76k. Spot is near 83k, between the put strike and the call strike at 93k.
author: jordan
